The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} appears as a collapsed section in the tunnels connecting the [[alchemy lab]], [[cellar]], [[barn cellar]], [[trade office]], [[dungeon]] and [[morgue]].  You will need to clear at least one blockage to get access to [[Snake]], the cultist.

There are also blockages between the [[apiary]] and the [[Forest near the river|upper forest area]] of the [[map]], as well as between the [[swamp]] and the [[quarry]]. The path from the [[workyard]] to the [[vineyard]] is blocked by a large fallen tree.

The old [[stone bridge]] and the [[swamp bridge]] need to be repaired as well.
